data.description: A twigjack can travel short distances between brambles, shrubs, or thickets as if via dimension door as part of a move action.  The twigjack must begin and end this movement while in an area of at least light undergrowth.  The twigjack can travel in this manner up to 60 feet per day.  This movement must be used in 10-foot increments and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
data.name: Bramble Jump
